title: Understanding the MERN Stack in 2024
excerpt: A deep dive into how MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js work together to build modern scalable web applications.
content:
The MERN stack continues to be one of the most popular choices for full-stack developers. In this article, we'll explore the benefits of using an all-JavaScript stack, discuss modern architecture patterns like Controller-Service-Repository, and look at how to optimize performance across all layers.

title: Mastering TypeScript with React

content:
